Hoffman and Sons Medical Group

Re: Daniel Casey (DOB 0g, 2025

I am writing this letter at the request of Daniel Casey, who has provided his consent for the release of his medical information. Mr. Casey was seen today regarding a suicide attempt. His blood pressure at time of this visit was 105/84, and he weighed 164 pounds. This visit marks his latest in a series of encounters for the same issue, which began approximately 19.5 years ago on February 17, 2006. Despite the duration of this struggle, Mr. Casey has been managing his condition well, and it is currently considered to be under control. 

Throughout his treatment, we have kept a close eye on his vital signs and overall health. For instance, on August 14, 2024, his blood pressure was 115/76, and he weighed 166 pounds. At that time, he was doing well. Similarly, on March 18, 2024, when blood pressure was recorded at 112/76 and he weighed 159 pounds, he was also doing well. 

Additionally, on October 2023, Mr. Casey’s blood pressure was 111/84, and he weighed 165 pounds, and again, he was doing well. On May 25, 2023, with a blood pressure of 111/81 and a weight of 156 pounds, he also doing well. During his visit on December 28, 2022, when his blood pressure was 115/83 and he weighed 157 pounds, we again noted that was doing well. 

On August 01, 2022, Mr. Casey came in for his annual physical. His blood pressure was 117/84, and he weighed 164 pounds. He was doing well at that time as well. It is also noteworthy that on March 05, 2022, he presented with an ankle sprain. His blood pressure was 117/83, and he weighed 162 pounds. He was doing well and his history of a suicide attempt, which began in 2006, was also noted during this visit.

Mr. Casey reports consuming approximately one alcoholic drink per week. His blood pressure and weight have been relatively stable over the years, reflecting his consistent efforts in managing his condition.

In summary, Mr. Casey has been under our care for a significant period, with consistent monitoring and management of his suicide attempt history. Despite the challenges, he has shown resilience and is currently managing his condition well. This comprehensive overview aims to provide a clear picture of his health status and ongoing care.

Should you have any further questions or require additional information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,

Dr. Scott Stokes 
Hoffman and Sons Medical Group
